rules.title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
rules.desc: In `transfer` or `transferFrom`, the token must call `identityRegistry.isVerified` to ensure the recipient is eligible.
rules.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "ERC-3643: invalid identity");

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface / transfer conditions (EIP doc)

rules.title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
rules.desc: Before executing transfers, token should invoke `compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount)` to enforce additional compliance rules.
rules.snippet: if (compliance != address(0)) require(compliance.canTransfer(from, to, amount), "ERC-3643: compliance failed");

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 spec — canTransfer in Token interface (EIP-3643)

rules.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
rules.desc: Claim Topics Registry must expose `addClaimTopic`, `removeClaimTopic`, `getClaimTopics`, and emit `ClaimTopicAdded`/`ClaimTopicRemoved` events.
rules.snippet: function addClaimTopic(uint256 _claimTopic); event ClaimTopicAdded(uint256 indexed claimTopic); function getClaimTopics() external view returns (uint256[] memory);

policy_refs.label: ERC-3643 docs — Claim Topics Registry interface and events
ERC-3643 docs — Claim Topics Registry interface and events

rules.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
rules.desc: Identity Registry should allow updating the associated ClaimTopicsRegistry via `setClaimTopicsRegistry(address)`.
rules.snippet: function setClaimTopicsRegistry(address _claimTopics);

policy_refs.label: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter methods
ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter methods

rules.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
rules.desc: Identity Registry must allow updating the Trusted Issuers Registry via `setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)`.
rules.snippet: function setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address _trustedIssuers);

policy_refs.label: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — setter for trusted issuers

rules.title: Identity Registry must expose isVerified view function
rules.desc: Identity Registry should have `isVerified(address)` to allow checking eligibility off-chain or from token.
rules.snippet: function isVerified(address userAddress) external view returns (bool);

policy_refs.label: ERC-3643 Identity Registry docs — isVerified definition

rules.title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
rules.desc: Token should emit `IdentityRegistryAdded(address)` and `ComplianceAdded(address)` events when wiring these contracts.
rules.snippet: event IdentityRegistryAdded(address indexed); event ComplianceAdded(address indexed);

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 specification — Token interface events list

rules.title: Token must support freezing / unfreezing of address
rules.desc: Token should implement `setAddressFrozen(address, bool)` or similar to control freezing of accounts.
rules.snippet: function setAddressFrozen(address _who, bool _frozen);

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 standard mentions freeze/unfreeze in Token interface / events section

rules.title: Token must be compatible with ERC-20 interface
rules.desc: ERC-3643 tokens must implement standard ERC-20 functions: `transfer`, `approve`, `allowance`, etc.
rules.snippet: function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool); function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 spec (requires ERC-20 compatibility)

rules.title: Token must support recovery functionality
rules.desc: Token should implement recovery mechanism in case an investor loses keys, e.g., `recover(address lost, address new)`.
rules.snippet: function recover(address _lostWallet, address _newWallet);

policy_refs.label: EIP-3643 specification — recovery function discussion in Token interface

rules.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD) before first transaction
rules.desc: The system should enforce identity verification (KYC) before any token transfer is executed.
rules.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "HKMA: CDD not met");

policy_refs.label: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §3.4 Customer due diligence and verification

rules.title: Record keeping retention ≥ 5 years
rules.desc: Audit or transaction logs must be kept for at least 5 years, retrievable on demand.
rules.snippet: event Transfer(...); // logs stored on chain + offchain retention

policy_refs.label: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline (2023) §9 Record keeping requirement

rules.title: Beneficial ownership identification
rules.desc: For entity accounts, beneficial owners must be identified and verified as part of KYC flow.
rules.snippet: if (account.isEntity) require(identityRegistry.verifyBeneficialOwner(account, owner), "HKMA: BO not verified");

policy_refs.label: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §4.4 Beneficial owner identification
HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §4.4 Beneficial owner identification

rules.title: Ongoing transaction monitoring / suspicious flags
rules.desc: Transfers exceeding thresholds or patterns should trigger flags / review logic.
rules.snippet: if (amount > threshold) emit SuspiciousTransfer(from, to, amount);

policy_refs.label: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §7 Transaction monitoring and reporting obligations

rules.title: Freezing high-risk accounts or sanctions screening
rules.desc: System supports freezing or blocking accounts identified as high risk or sanctioned.
rules.snippet: function freezeAddress(address who) external onlyOwner;

policy_refs.label: HKMA AML/CFT Guideline §5 Risk mitigation / enhanced due diligence

rules.title: Client identity rule: identity on file prior to transaction
rules.desc: Before executing token-related operations, verify that client identity info is on file compliant with SFC §5.4.
rules.snippet: require(identityRegistry.isVerified(to), "SFC: identity not on file");

policy_refs.label: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — Code of Conduct paragraph 5.4

rules.title: Timely disclosure of client identity to regulators
rules.desc: Client identity records must be retrievable and deliverable to regulators within required timeframe.
rules.snippet: function exportClientInfo(address who) external view returns (ClientInfo);

policy_refs.label: SFC Client Identity Rule Policy — regulators can request identity info within 2 business days

rules.title: Record changes in identity / KYC data
rules.desc: When identity or KYC status changes, the system must emit an event for auditability.
rules.snippet: event IdentityUpdated(address indexed who, string reason);

policy_refs.label: SFC Code of Conduct §12 (Compliance obligations) — record keeping, control obligations

rules.title: Internal control & compliance function oversight
rules.desc: The token-related operations must respect separation of roles, oversight, and error control.
rules.snippet: // administrative actions only via governance or compliance module

policy_refs.label: SFC Code of Conduct §12.1 General compliance obligations

rules.title: Conflicts of interest disclosure & fairness
rules.desc: If token logic includes privileged roles, their actions should be transparent via events or logs.
rules.snippet: event AdminAction(address indexed who, string action);

policy_refs.label: SFC Code of Conduct §5 & §11 (fair treatment, disclosure)
